articles.title: A Tiny Space Rock Just Got Its Own Atmosphere—and Scientists Are Buzzing!
articles.summary: Imagine a rock smaller than our Moon wearing a gas coat! That's 2002 XV93, a space rock in the Kuiper Belt. Scientists found it has an atmosphere—something only big planets like Pluto were thought to have. How? They watched it pass in front of a star and saw the starlight bend.

articles.title: Jannik Sinner's Super-Speedy Slam: He Just Won Every Big Tennis Prize!
articles.summary: At just 24, Italian tennis star Jannik Sinner won the Italian Open and completed the 'Golden Masters'—winning all nine of the biggest tournaments below the Grand Slams. Only Novak Djokovic did it before, but Sinner did it way faster. Now he's aiming for the French Open to make even more history.

articles.title: No More 4 AM Meows! These Smart Cat Feeders Are Game-Changers
articles.summary: Tired of your cat waking you up for breakfast? New automatic feeders use apps and AI to schedule meals, prevent overeating, and even let you video-chat with your kitty. WIRED tested 11 top models, including one that keeps wet food fresh like a mini-fridge. Your sleep—and your cat—will thank you.
